//: Uvicorn's logging config, passed with --log-config so it applies before
uvicorn writes its first line. Without it the startup banner ('Started
server process', 'Application startup complete') goes out as plain text
ahead of the app's lifespan, which is where configure_logging() runs —
so the very first lines of the stream would be unparseable to anything
reading it as one JSON object per line (meridian_core/logging.py).
The access logger is disabled here as well as by --no-access-log, so the
format holds even if that flag is dropped from the CMD. The app's own
middleware logs each request structurally, with a run_id.
